verdict.summary: Static review found no concrete new correctness or security defects within the added Cowork source, optional _load digest feature, or one-time Mac GUI bootstrap. The bootstrap requires interactive owner review before launch and checks daemon health before requesting owner-operated OS permissions. No tools or code were executed during this review. The reported CLI and Cowork verification results were not independently rerun; live GUI retrieval and OS permissions remain explicitly unverified and pending, not code defects.
